mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers a negative equity market reaction, with the effect amplified when both series fall below their 3-month moving averages.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In stagflation regimes (INDPRO < 110 and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), supply chain disruptions combined with high inflation erode corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 110 and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) above its 6-month moving average signals strong household demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL has exceeded 3.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a severe labor market slowdown that triggers a negative equity market reaction, with the effect amplified when both series move in the same direction for two months.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising), a concurrent slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO < 112) signals an economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and INDPRO < 112.
